label: Liquipedia Elo, end of 2010 (1.6 and Source)

source.name: Liquipedia
source.method: the Elo of every 5v5 series of 1.6 and Source in Liquipedia's S-, A- and B-Tier events from 2000-12-08 to the end of 2010, a series that records no map counted as one, each game an Elo of its own, a player of both rated in the one he played more of that year (docs/design/counter-strike.md, "Earlier seasons")
source.conversion: rating = Elo / 25 − 2, rounded; each newcomer started at his region's level as the maps to 2010-12-31 measure it (1.6: AF 1364, ASIA 1488, CIS 1479, EU 1500, MENA 1290, NA 1476, OCE 1435, SA 1394; Source: ASIA 1272, CIS 1545, EU 1500, MENA 1480, NA 1566, OCE 1517, SA 1399; fitted at once with every player's own strength, Europe's at 1,500: docs/design/counter-strike.md, "Regions")
